question: Who inaugurated the SheLeads II programme in New Delhi?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Annpurna Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Annpurna Devi Inaugurates SheLeads II to Boost Women’s Leadership.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Union Minister Annpurna Devi** inaugurated **SheLeads II** in **New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
The event is a **two-day workshop** by the **UN Women India Country Office**.

 
 
• 
 
SheLeads is UN Women’s **flagship capacity-building programme**.

 
 
• 
 
It aims to promote **gender equality in political and public leadership**.

 
 
• 
 
The event follows the **Women’s Reservation Act, 2023**, mandating **33% reservation** for women in **Lok Sabha** and **State Assemblies**.

 
 
• 
 
The programme supports women to contest in upcoming **Lok Sabha and Assembly elections**.

 
 
• 
 
SheLeads equips women with **skills, networks, and confidence** to lead.

 
 
• 
 
It brings together **grassroots women leaders**, **elected representatives**, and **administrators**.

 
 
• 
 
Focuses on fostering **dialogue**, building **leadership capacity**, and increasing **women’s participation in governance**.
